Bapuji brings back Madhavi’s mortgaged gold jewelry, while the police assure Bhide that his seized cash will be returned following legal formalities. A repentant Bhide takes to heart that greed brings only trouble and vows to teach this lesson to his students.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
